summary: BEAUTY HOUSE HASAN (org. no. 928 704 122) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Nordre Follo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2022-02-08. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 96.210 (Frisering og barbering); it has 0 registered employees.
